O-1043 (City of Ashford Bike Share) has a late penalty and is short 10 bikes (90 of its 100 bikes ship on time; the other 10 are ready day 26). Any revised schedule should be checked with check_coverage before it's accepted.
Whether and how to tell City of Ashford Bike Share (O-1043), Main Street Bikes (O-1044) and Lakeview Rentals (O-1045) about the delays.
